claims.qualification: The page lists two founders; Calcalist (reporting) names Amnon Shashua as a third. Calcalist’s report also names this person as a co-founder.

evidence.passage: The founders section lists Yoav Shoham as chairman and co-founder.
AI21 Labs was founded in 2017 by Prof. Yoav Shoham, Ori Goshen, and Prof. Amnon Shashua.

claims.subject: yoav-shoham
claims.statement: AI21 Labs’ company page describes Yoav Shoham as Google’s former Principal Scientist.

time.note: Undated biography; no dates for the Google role are given.

claims.qualification: A company biography of its own co-founder; it does not establish dates or the Google unit.

evidence.passage: The biography describes Shoham as a professor emeritus at Stanford and Google’s former Principal Scientist.

claims.subject: yi-tay
claims.statement: Yi Tay wrote on his blog on 25 November 2024 that he had joined and co-founded Reka.

time.note: First-person retrospective statement of 25 November 2024; no founding date is given.

claims.qualification: A first-person statement; it does not name the other founders or give a founding date. The Decoder’s report (reporting) also calls him a co-founder.

evidence.locator: Section “Reflections on my Reka arc”, first sentence
evidence.passage: I’m thankful for all the things I got to learn and experience from joining and co-founding Reka.
Co-founder and Chief Scientist Yi Tay is a former member of the Google Brain team

claims.subject: andrew-tulloch
claims.statement: Reuters reported on 11 October 2025 that Andrew Tulloch was a co-founder of Thinking Machines Lab.

time.note: Retrospective description in an 11 October 2025 wire report; no founding date for the person is given.

claims.qualification: The record rests on reporting (a Reuters wire retrieved as syndicated by TradingView, teaser text only); no company or first-person statement was retrieved.

evidence.passage: Reuters described Andrew Tulloch as the co-founder of Mira Murati’s Thinking Machines Lab.

claims.subject: barret-zoph
claims.statement: TechCrunch reported on 14 January 2026 that Barret Zoph was a co-founder of Thinking Machines Lab.

time.note: Retrospective description in a 14 January 2026 report; no founding date for the person is given.

claims.qualification: The record rests on reporting (TechCrunch); no company or first-person statement naming Zoph as co-founder was retrieved.

evidence.passage: Murati announced the departure of Barret Zoph, the company’s co-founder and CTO.
co-founded Thinking Machines with Zoph and Metz

claims.subject: greg-brockman
claims.statement: Greg Brockman posted on X on 6 August 2024 (UTC) that he had co-founded OpenAI nine years earlier.

time.note: The post gives no founding date; “9 years ago” in a post of August 2024 is the author’s approximation and is not converted into a date here.

claims.qualification: A retrospective self-description. OpenAI’s 2015 launch announcement names Brockman as CTO (existing record); the post does not establish a legal founder status.

evidence.passage: Brockman’s post refers to his co-founding OpenAI nine years earlier.
